title: 苹果硬件传奇：被挖OpenAI？，合作而非跳槽
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Ed Ledlow, host of Bloomberg Tech, joins us now here in New York for more on the two giants' relationship, Souring.
segments.zh: 彭博科技主持人埃德·莱德洛在纽约与我们连线，探讨两大巨头关系承压。

segments.en: This is kind of a window into what you've talked so much about this war for talent in Silicon Valley right now, centering on AI.
segments.zh: 这反映了硅谷围绕AI的人才争夺战。

segments.en: I'm interested in mentioning those names, Tang Tan, Johnny Ive, Legends kind of of Apple's hardware operation have been brought over to open AI to work on new products there.
segments.zh: 唐坦、乔纳森·艾维等苹果硬件传奇人物被挖到OpenAI开发新产品。

segments.en: What does this story say about that broader fight that's taking place? Well, I mean, this is a big story, and I would say probably actually as much about Silicon Valley's look to the future
segments.zh: 这背后是硅谷对未来硬件的布局。

segments.en: of hardware as much as it is the people. You know, if you think about the landscape of Apple and meta, as examples, trying to work out how people consume
segments.zh: 苹果和Meta等公司都在探索用户如何通过不同设备使用AI。

segments.en: is use AI through different device form factors.
segments.zh: 智能手机是主流，但眼镜、别针等新形态正在兴起。

segments.en: The smartphone is what we mostly use, but glasses are coming in, people have tried pins.
That's kind of the underlying layer of the story, which is interesting.
segments.zh: 但苹果对OpenAI的经济和法律压力非常严峻。

segments.en: But in terms of Apple versus Open AI, the sort of full economic and litigating might of Apple against Open AI, it's very serious.
segments.zh: 这对OpenAI进军硬件意味着什么？

segments.en: You just referenced it, but what does this mean for Open AI when it comes to trying to expand into hardware?
segments.zh: 你刚才提到了，这对OpenAI进军硬件意味着什么？

segments.en: And when it comes to actually making money from people using AI, which is a bit of a...
segments.zh: 至于如何从用户使用AI中真正获利，这还有点……

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, in the suit, Apple describes Open AI's hardware effort as nascent, but you gave the key details,
segments.zh: 在诉讼中，苹果称OpenAI的硬件努力尚在初期，但你提到了关键细节，

segments.en: which is that Apple claims are about 400 Apple alumni now working at Open AI and the specifics
segments.zh: 即苹果声称约有400名苹果前员工现在在OpenAI工作，以及具体细节。
